Book correction: The answer key (printed as number 21, not 18) gives 2y^3 - 3xy^2 + 6x^2y = 6x^3\ln|C(y + x)|. This does not satisfy the equation as printed. It is the solution when the denominator is y^3 instead of y^3 - x^3: then x\frac{dv}{dx} = \frac{1 + v}{v^3}, \frac{v^3}{v + 1} = v^2 - v + 1 - \frac{1}{v + 1}, and integration gives 2v^3 - 3v^2 + 6v = 6\ln|Cx(v + 1)|, which is the key's answer.
